title: Special repairs and maintenance of Kannur Lighthouse
summary: Two-cover e-tender for special repairs and maintenance of Kannur Lighthouse, Kannur District, Kerala, under the Cochin Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

scope.item: Special repairs and maintenance of Kannur Lighthouse

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to be submitted physically by the due date. Bid Securing Declaration also listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%
Similar works: erection of trestle/lighthouse/communication tower or construction/maintenance of residential/institutional/office buildings, roads or related civil construction
CA-certified annual turnover for last three years
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper of not being blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Accounts officers in MoPSW/DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; tender acceptance letter; bid securing declaration
notes: Document is Section I (NIT) only, printed pages 2-6; no BOQ or item-wise scope. Hindi text layer is font-garbled but English values are complete. Bid submission period 04.09.2026 (1800 hrs) to 25.09.2026 (1500 hrs); bid query last date 08.09.2026; last date of EMD 24.09.2026. Eligibility item 4 and 5 (turnover certificate) are duplicated in the notice.
